purpose: Close the invalid initial C3 dense-only evaluation with a preregistered, read-only, dense PRE/POST shadow comparison that isolates SemanticQueryBuilder text construction.

findings.A: The initial dense-only T2 ran without the authoritative populated dense index.
findings.B: PRE and POST retrieval metrics were both zero and could not evaluate C3 behavior.
findings.C: The committed root runner computed only MRR while the completion report claimed Recall@5, Recall@10, Recall@20, and critical evidence coverage.
findings.D: Unmeasured metrics were incorrectly reported as 0.0 instead of N/A.
findings.E: The committed C3 artifact was a minimal 13-line implementation-status record without preregistration, metrics, provenance, or cost information.
findings.F: The initial case list included excluded case g016.
findings.G: The initial case IDs were hardcoded without a durable preregistration artifact.
findings.H: docs/EVALUATION_STATUS.md contained contradictory C3 PASS/NOT_STARTED and C1 INCONCLUSIVE/overall PASS claims.
findings.I: Tracked user_input.txt was an accidental transcript artifact.

preregistration.eligible_set_rule: effective_product_language=en under the reviewed calibration; split=dev; review_status=approved; expected_status=answered; required_evidence_groups and required_answer_points are present

selection_algorithm.description: Group eligible cases by Gold intent, sort case IDs within each intent, iterate a fixed intent order, and take one case per non-empty intent per round until primary has 12; continue the same untouched queues for four preregistered reserves.

preregistration.reserve_policy: Run primary cases first. Run reserve IDs only in locked order if fewer than three primary cases have SemanticQuery.text != raw question, stopping once three changed cases are observed or all reserves are exhausted.

applicability.ordinary_metrics: Gold expected_status=answered only; Recall@5/10/20 and MRR use existing required-evidence-group matching semantics.
applicability.critical_coverage: Use existing critical required-evidence-group labels when applicable; otherwise record N/A. Do not infer criticality from prior failures.

pre_condition.plan: one analyzer RetrievalPlan reused for both conditions
pre_condition.filter: case-specific plan target repository/version filter constructed once

post_condition.plan: same in-memory analyzer RetrievalPlan as PRE
post_condition.filter: same object or canonical-equivalent filter as PRE

preregistration.treatment_coverage_requirement: At least three executed cases must have SemanticQuery.text != raw question; otherwise C3-R1 is INCONCLUSIVE.
acceptance_rules: Use the populated authoritative dense index.
PRE and POST reuse exactly one analyzer plan per case.
PRE and POST filters are identical.
All required metrics are genuinely calculated; unmeasured values are N/A.
POST aggregate Recall@20 is not below PRE aggregate Recall@20.
No applicable critical-evidence coverage regression occurs.
Raw question remains first-class and no expansion-only contamination occurs.
No writes, document embeddings, reindexing, sparse, fusion, reranker, selector, QA, or judge calls occur.
All-zero PRE and POST Recall@20 across applicable cases is INCONCLUSIVE.
